bypassHosts.message: Bypass hosts (one per line, comma or semicolon separated)

runtimeAuditHint.message: Active identity status and consistency audit

collectionNotice.message: Activating a profile can request the egress IP from ipwho.is. A proxied profile shows that provider the proxy address. A direct profile shows it your own public IP, and only after you allow that collection. The location picker starts offline. Loading the online map shares your connection’s public IP and viewed area with OpenFreeMap after explicit consent. Coordinates and all map interactions work offline. No telemetry and no remotely loaded code.

shimLimitNotice.message: Page-level geolocation and timezone changes are compatibility shims. They are observable by sophisticated page scripts and are not a claim of fingerprinting invisibility.

guideText1.message: A profile applies one network identity together: how Firefox connects, the location pages see, the timezone pages see, and WebRTC address handling. Choose Direct or a proxy row to activate it. Off releases identity and WebRTC control. Save stores edits; Save & Activate applies them.

guideText3.message: Browser routing uses Firefox's own connection. It does not turn off a proxy you set in Firefox or on this computer. Choose an HTTP, HTTPS, or SOCKS proxy when this profile should send traffic through a specific server.

guideText5.message: Automatic asks where the connection appears to come from. That place is approximate, about 20 km, not a GPS fix. A proxied profile shows the proxy's address. Browser routing shows your own public address and waits until you allow that. Manual lets you type coordinates or pick them on the map. The map still works when its pictures cannot load.

guideText7.message: The WebRTC policy limits which network addresses a page can learn. If another extension or a Firefox policy already controls that setting, this extension leaves it alone and says so.

guideText9.message: An unreachable proxy or a missing password stops the new identity and keeps the previous page location, instead of revealing your real one. Refresh Identity tries the lookup again. A frame the browser will not inject into can still see the computer's timezone; that limit is reported, not hidden.

savedPending.message: Saved changes are pending. Apply to update the active route.

saveApplyNotice.message: Save stores edits. Apply activates the saved configuration; unsaved edits stay in the form.

manualOverrideNotice.message: Custom overrides are applied as entered. A manual location or timezone may disagree with the observed network location.

manualOverrideShort.message: Custom overrides are applied as entered; they may differ from the observed network location.

longitudeTimezoneWarning.message: The manual timezone appears far from this longitude. Your choices will be applied unchanged.

manualAccuracyNotice.message: Manual coordinates are applied to pages as-is, with the accuracy you provide.

socks4AuthHint.message: Firefox does not support authentication for SOCKS4 proxies, so a username and password are ignored.

httpAuthHint.message: HTTP/HTTPS proxy credentials are sent as a preemptive Basic header and, when the proxy demands a challenge, answered only for this proxy.

socks5AuthHint.message: SOCKS5 credentials are passed to Firefox as SOCKS authentication.

proxyDnsExplanation.message: Proxy DNS routes name resolution through the proxy. Firefox applies this to SOCKS proxies only.
